problem.question: Madeline needs $1200 to pay rent, $400 for groceries, $200 for medical expenses, and $60 for utilities. She also wants to save $200 in case of an emergency. She makes $15 per hour at her job. How many hours will Madeline need to work this month?
problem.answer:
Madeline needs 1200+400+200+60+200 = $<<1200+400+200+60+200=2060>>2060 to pay all of her bills.
She will need to work $2060/$15 per hour = 137.33 hours.
She will need to work 138 hours to pay all of her bills
